answer: Give every agent a copper-backed beacon license. First, it stakes 50 copper tokens and registers a beacon address that pings hourly. Second, each ping carries a cipher proof only its licensed key can make, so a copied identity fails the next ping. Third, peers watch the history, and any gap over three hours suspends trading until the agent re-verifies with a new stake. Forging 10,000 fakes would burn 500,000 copper tokens, about $250,000, plus 10,000 keys and 30 days of nonstop ping spoofing. Like a lighthouse keeper tending the lamp nightly, an agent that stops proving itself goes dark.
